description: Refactor Jupyter notebooks into standalone Python scripts and create Airflow DAG for SageMaker Unified Studio Workflow orchestration

userStories.title: Implement structured JSON logging utility
userStories.description: As an operator, I want structured JSON logs so I can query them in CloudWatch Logs Insights.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `log_json()` function in `scripts/utils.py`

Function accepts: level, message, and **kwargs for extra fields
Include script_name, step, and duration_ms support in extra fields
Logs written to stdout via print()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement S3 credential fallback utility

acceptanceCriteria: Create `get_bucket_name()` function in `scripts/utils.py`

userStories.title: Create clean_data.py script
userStories.description: As a workflow orchestrator, I need a standalone script to clean raw machine data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `scripts/clean_data.py` with argparse for --input-path and --output-path arguments
Load CSV from input path using pandas.read_csv()
Remove rows with missing temperature or room_temp using dropna(subset=[...])
Convert timestamp column to datetime using pd.to_datetime()
Sort by timestamp ascending with sort_values().reset_index(drop=True)
Save to output path as Parquet using to_parquet(index=False)
Log input rows, removed rows, output rows using log_json from utils
Return exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure (use sys.exit)
Script has if __name__ == '__main__': main() entry point
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create feature_engineering.py script
userStories.description: As a workflow orchestrator, I need a standalone script to create ML features from cleaned data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `scripts/feature_engineering.py` with argparse for --input-path and --output-path arguments
Load Parquet from input path using pandas.read_parquet()
Create temp_diff column: df['temp_diff'] = df['temperature'] - df['room_temp']
Create overheat column: df['overheat'] = (df['temperature'] > 80).astype(int)
Select only columns: temperature, temp_diff, overheat
Save to output path as Parquet using to_parquet(index=False)
Log input rows, mean temp_diff, overheat percentage using log_json from utils
Return exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure (use sys.exit)
Script has if __name__ == '__main__': main() entry point
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create train_model.py script with MLflow integration
userStories.description: As a workflow orchestrator, I need a standalone script to train the ML model with MLflow experiment tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `scripts/train_model.py` with argparse arguments: --input-path, --model-output, --experiment-name (default='machine-overheat'), --test-size (default=0.2)
Do NOT call mlflow.set_tracking_uri() - it is auto-injected in SageMaker Unified Studio
Call mlflow.set_experiment(args.experiment_name) to set experiment
Load features from input-path using pandas.read_parquet()
Split data: X = df[['temperature', 'temp_diff']], y = df['overheat']
Use train_test_split with test_size and stratify=y and random_state=42
Train LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)
Inside mlflow.start_run(): log params (model_type, test_size, random_state)
Calculate and log metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score
Log model using mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, 'model')
Save model to model-output path using joblib.dump()
Log input rows, accuracy, and training duration using log_json from utils
Return exit code 0 on success, 1 on failure
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add error handling to train_model.py
userStories.description: As an operator, I need clear error messages when training fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap main training logic in try/except block
On exception: log structured error with level=ERROR, error_type, and message
On exception: log full traceback using traceback.format_exc()
On exception: call sys.exit(1)
Validate input file exists and has required columns (temperature, temp_diff, overheat)
Validate accuracy >= 0.85, log warning if below threshold
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Airflow DAG for ML pipeline
userStories.description: As a workflow orchestrator, I need an Airflow DAG to orchestrate the ML pipeline steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `workflows/machine_overheat_dag.py`
Import: DAG, PythonOperator from airflow, datetime, timedelta, subprocess
Define default_args dict with owner='ml-team', retries=1, retry_delay=timedelta(minutes=5)
Create DAG with dag_id='machine_overheat_pipeline', schedule_interval=None, start_date=datetime(2026,1,1), catchup=False, tags=['ml','overheat']
Create helper function run_script(script_name, args) that uses subprocess.run() to execute scripts
Create task clean_data using PythonOperator calling run_script('clean_data.py', input/output args)
Create task feature_engineering using PythonOperator calling run_script('feature_engineering.py', input/output args)
Create task train_model using PythonOperator calling run_script('train_model.py', input/output args)
Set dependencies: clean_data >> feature_engineering >> train_model
Add docstring explaining the DAG purpose and steps
Typecheck passes
